# endlesstech.blog

> Practitioner blog on Microsoft 365 security, Intune, Entra ID and Zero Trust —
> written by Philipp Schmidt, IT consultant (15+ years, Windows NT to M365).
> Hands-on, vendor-neutral guides for IT practitioners, MSP technicians and SMB
> admins. Every article is grounded in real tenant work, not marketing.

## Zero Trust for Microsoft 365 (4-part series)

The model Microsoft Secure Score actually measures: Identity, Devices, Apps, Data.

- [Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 1: Securing Identity](https://endlesstech.blog/posts/2026-08-11-zero-trust-m365-identity.html) — Identity is the first pillar of Zero Trust for Microsoft 365 and the highest-impact category in Secure Score.
- [Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 2: Securing Devices](https://endlesstech.blog/posts/2026-08-12-zero-trust-m365-devices.html) — Devices are the second Zero Trust pillar for Microsoft 365.
- [Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 3: Securing Apps](https://endlesstech.blog/posts/2026-08-13-zero-trust-m365-apps.html) — Apps are the third Zero Trust pillar for Microsoft 365.
- [Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 4: Securing Data](https://endlesstech.blog/posts/2026-08-14-zero-trust-m365-data.html) — Data is the fourth Zero Trust pillar for Microsoft 365 and the one the other three exist to protect.
